source_text: Ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τῆς συντελείας ἀφαιρεῖται τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον· οὐ γὰρ οἷόν τε σὺν τῷ πνεύματι δοθῆναί τινα εἰς κόλασιν.
pass_a_gloss: In the time of the completion is-taken-away the spirit the holy; for not possible with the spirit to-be-given someone into punishment.
pass_b_english: In the time of the completion the Holy Spirit is taken away; for it is not possible for someone to be given over to punishment together with the Spirit.
